articles.author: INLIF Ltd
articles.headline: INLIF LIMITED Reports First Half of Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
articles.summary: INLIF reports unaudited first-half results, including approximately $1.01 million net income compared with a prior-year $1.98 million loss and a new intelligent-equipment revenue contribution. The June 30 reporting period is distinct from the September 24 release date.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original PR Newswire release and Stockwatch reproduction identify September 24 at 16:30 ET; Finviz agrees. The attached SEC exhibit corroborates the release contents.

limitations: Partial review of the exact listed entries only; other entries and older sessions remain unreviewed.
